sources.claim: ESET reports determining from source code and backend samples that RedLine Stealer and META Stealer share the same creator.
DOJ describes META Infostealer as closely related to RedLine Infostealer in Operation Magnus.

curator_note: Modeled as shared creator, not aliasing. RedLine and MetaStealer stay separate malware-family nodes.
confidence_reason: ESET reports source-code/backend-sample analysis supporting a same-creator conclusion, and DOJ independently frames META as closely related to RedLine.
